summary: Underneath it, a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you think and talk your way through anything and you build things that last and carry real weight. At the edge, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
body: Underneath it, a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you think and talk your way through anything and you build things that last and carry real weight. At the edge, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk. Speaking freely may not always feel easy. Thoughts can feel weighed against rules, consequences, or the fear of being wrong.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
integration: Let thinking and speech and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you build things that last work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
